## Quarto

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
mrp <- read_csv("../../data/clean/mrp-2013-2016-clean.csv")
pop_weight <- read_csv("../../data/clean/pop-weight-2013-2026-clean.csv")
```

```{r}
stan_data <- list(
  N = length(mrp$q2),
  income = mrp$inc_idx,
  education = mrp$edu_idx,
  age = mrp$age_idx,
  state = mrp$state_idx,
  y = mrp$q2,
  p = pop_weight$N
)


mod <- cmdstan_model(
  "models/ar.stan",
  stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE)
)

fit <- mod$sample(
  data = stan_data,
  refresh = 0,
  show_messages = FALSE,
  show_exceptions = FALSE
)
```
